problem: A failed ambient model response (provider_reaction_format) stopped the shared PCM stream indefinitely while the board remained connected.
changes: Isolate failed utterances from continuous audio capture; retain failed turn records in SQLite.
Detect missing PCM for 8 seconds and restart transient audio/ASR faults with 1-30 second backoff.
Cancel recovery on user pause/disconnect; exclude enrollment, storage faults and critical device state from automatic retries.
Expose last_turn_error and recovery_count in local management UI.
limits: Short runtime observation; overnight stability and physical response to the next user utterance remain unverified.
